chunks: Whoever gives a loan until ease of repayment, his wealth is in zakat, and he remains in the salat of the angels upon him until he takes it back.

key_terms.الْمَلَائِكَةِ: the angels who pray for the lender
key_terms.زَكَاةٍ: purifying charitable merit associated with the wealth in this context
key_terms.قَرْضًا: a loan extended to another person
key_terms.يَقْبِضَهُ: takes it back or receives repayment

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for giving a loan and allowing repayment until ease?
ai.summary: This hadith encourages giving a loan and allowing the borrower respite until repayment becomes easy. It describes such an act as a source of ongoing spiritual reward, linking the lender’s wealth with zakat and promising the prayers of the angels until the loan is repaid.
